# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 44 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Confession

---

**1** 'O my children, I am the cause of all your suffering and toil on the earth. If I had not eaten from the forbidden tree, none of this would have fallen on you.'

**2** All her children wept: 'Mother, don't condemn yourself — God is merciful.'

**3** Eve said: 'I confess my sin before God and before all of you. I trust in God's mercy to forgive me.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
